item.title: [INTC] Dow back above 50,000, US stocks hit new records on AI rally
item.description: US stocks (^DJI, ^IXIC, ^GSPC) close Thursday's session higher after the Dow Jones Industrial Average crossed back above 50,000 points on the winds of the latest AI rally. Yahoo Finance Senior Markets Reporter Ines Ferré highlights the leaders and biggest gainers in the semiconductor trade.

item.title: [NVDA] What the Trump–Xi summit in China could mean for Nvidia
item.description: President Trump's summit in China with President Xi is underway, with Nvidia (NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang and Tesla (TSLA) CEO Elon Musk tagging along. Yahoo Finance Technology Editor Dan Howley explains what talks in China could mean for Nvidia.

item.title: [AAPL] Fortress Private Ledger Buys $2.8 Million Worth of FEGE -- a Global Equity ETF Outpacing the S&P 500
item.description: This actively managed ETF invests across U.S. and global equities, with a one-year price gain outpacing the S&P 500.
